import TransposeFollowup.RowCellMachine
open TransposeFollowup

def identityMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def doubleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 2
  b := 0
  c := 0
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1 / 2
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def fractionalMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1
  b := 0
  c := 1
  d := 1
  lo := 0
  hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num


def shiftMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := -1; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def poleMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := -2; d := 1; lo := 0; hi := 1 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def coefficientMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1 / 2; b := 1 / 3; c := 1 / 5; d := 1; lo := -1 / 2; hi := 3 / 4
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def outsideMap : RationalMobius where
  a := 1; b := 0; c := 0; d := 1; lo := 2; hi := 3
  interval_nonempty := by norm_num
  determinant_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_lo_pos := by norm_num
  denominator_hi_pos := by norm_num

def cases : List RationalMobius :=
  [identityMap, doubleMap, fractionalMap, shiftMap, poleMap, coefficientMap, outsideMap]


open RowCell FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def bits (m a : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map a.testBit

def wordIndex : WordPort → Nat
  | (g,side,sign) => 4*(match g with | .threshold => 0 | .crossing => 1 | .delta => 2) +
      2*side.toNat+sign.toNat

def portIndex : Port → Nat
  | .word p => wordIndex p | .fuel => 12 | .zero => 13 | .scratch b => 14+b.toNat

def allWordPorts : List WordPort :=
  [Group.threshold,.crossing,.delta].flatMap (fun g =>
    [false,true].flatMap (fun side => [false,true].map (fun sign => (g,side,sign))))

def allPorts : List Port := allWordPorts.map Port.word ++ [.fuel,.zero,.scratch false,.scratch true]

def heads (p : Port) : Int := 7*(portIndex p : Int)-43

def encoded (m : Nat) (values : WordPort → Nat) : Words := fun p => bits m (values p)

def expectedAnswer (guard : Bool) (v : WordPort → Nat) : Bool :=
  guard && decide ((v (.threshold,false,false):Int)-v (.threshold,false,true) <
    (v (.crossing,false,false):Int)-v (.crossing,false,true)) &&
    decide ((v (.crossing,true,false):Int)-v (.crossing,true,true) <
      (v (.threshold,true,false):Int)-v (.threshold,true,true))

def modularAnswer (guard : Bool) (m : Nat) (v : WordPort → Nat) : Bool :=
  guard && decide ((v (.threshold,false,false)+v (.crossing,false,true))%2^m <
    (v (.crossing,false,false)+v (.threshold,false,true))%2^m) &&
    decide ((v (.crossing,true,false)+v (.threshold,true,true))%2^m <
      (v (.threshold,true,false)+v (.crossing,true,true))%2^m)

def nextValues (m : Nat) (v : WordPort → Nat) : WordPort → Nat
  | (.crossing,i) => (v (.crossing,i)+v (.delta,i))%2^m
  | p => v p

def checkCase (guard : Bool) (m : Nat) (v : WordPort → Nat) (answer : Bool) : Bool := Id.run do
  let initial := ready m (encoded m v)
  let final := NativeZipper.run program (118*m+284)
    (zipperCfg (.first guard (.add false (.scan false false))) initial heads)
  let clean := fun b => decide ((final.core.tapes (.scratch b)).left = [.start]) &&
    (final.core.tapes (.scratch b)).right.all (fun s => decide (s = .blank))
  return decide (final.core.pc = .done answer) &&
    allWordPorts.all (fun p => decide (final.core.tapes (.word p) = BinaryCarry.marked (bits m (nextValues m v p)))) &&
    decide (final.core.tapes .fuel = initial .fuel) && decide (final.core.tapes .zero = initial .zero) &&
    clean false && clean true && allPorts.all (fun p => decide (final.pos p = heads p))

def rowValues (r : ComponentRow) (j : Nat) : WordPort → Nat
  | (g,side,sign) =>
    let pair := match g with
      | .threshold => if side then r.upper else r.lower
      | .delta => if side then r.deltaRight else r.deltaLeft
      | .crossing => if side then r.deltaRight.scale j else r.deltaLeft.scale (j+1)
    if sign then pair.negative else pair.positive

def cellChecks : Nat × Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut raw := 0
  let mut rational := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for seed in List.range 256 do
    let m := seed%8
    let guard := seed%2 == 0
    let v := fun p => (seed*17+(wordIndex p)*13+seed/(wordIndex p+1))%2^m
    raw := raw+1
    if !(checkCase guard m v (modularAnswer guard m v)) then failures := failures+1
  for F in cases do
    for n in List.range 6 do
      for i in List.finRange n do
        let r := F.componentRow i
        let guard := r.sourceLeft.less r.sourceRight
        let m := F.componentWidth n
        for j in List.finRange n do
          rational := rational+1
          let v := rowValues r j.val
          if expectedAnswer guard v != F.overlapTest i j then failures := failures+1
          if !(checkCase guard m v (F.overlapTest i j)) then failures := failures+1
  return (raw,rational,failures)
#eval cellChecks
